source_inputs.title: XENO — Trainingsumfang, Sprachspezifikation, Messwerte
source_inputs.scope: Qwen3.5-0.8B measurement/training handoff; noncanonical where current GitHub authority differs
material_points: semantic readout is reported strong while dynamic codebook binding, context transfer and symbolic inference are weak
concepts are reported as rank-2-to-4 subspaces rather than one direction
Hyperposition is defined as a branch set with branch-local context, evidence, counterevidence, falsifier, validity, provenance and epistemic status
carrier binding capacity is reported as non-blocking at the measured scope

source_inputs.citation: Wu, Geiger, Milliere (ICML 2025), How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?
source_inputs.method_input: Training can pass through a shallow heuristic phase before systematic variable binding; causal interventions identified learned routing/addressable-memory mechanisms.

source_inputs.citation: Sharma, Dawes, Raval (2026), Dissociating Decodability and Causal Use in Bracket-Sequence Transformers
source_inputs.method_input: Multiple internal variables can be linearly decodable while their causal contribution to behavior differs sharply.

source_inputs.citation: Yuan, Su (2026), Beyond Language: Format-Agnostic Reasoning Subspaces in Large Language Models
source_inputs.method_input: Cross-form reasoning can concentrate in a low-dimensional subspace and should be tested with cross-form generalization plus intervention, not surface-form accuracy alone.

source_inputs.citation: Makelov, Lange, Geiger, Nanda (ICLR 2024), Is This the Subspace You Are Looking for? An Interpretability Illusion for Subspace Activation Patching
source_inputs.method_input: A successful subspace intervention can still exploit a dormant parallel path and therefore does not by itself identify the faithful mechanism.

source_inputs.citation: Kim (ICML 2026 Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop), Non-linear Interventions on Large Language Models
source_inputs.method_input: Failure of linear intervention need not imply absence of a feature if the relevant representation lies on a nonlinear manifold.

audited_current_artifacts.delta: Its probe-is-diagnostic rule is correct; strengthen C/Hyperposition acceptance from probe-plus-behavior to an explicit representation-plus-causal-use evidence ladder.

The contract currently treats same causal_ancestry_id as duplicate evidence. Correlation ancestry and exact event identity should be distinct so correlated-but-distinct observations remain provenance-visible without receiving independent-evidence credit.

_already_seen returns true on either evidence_id equality or causal_ancestry_id equality. Preserve exact-event idempotence, but explicitly test whether distinct events sharing ancestry must remain recorded as correlated observations rather than silently disappear.
Add correlated-distinct-vs-exact-duplicate evidence families, branch-ID permutation families, and cross-surface semantic-equivalence families before scaling.

audited_current_artifacts.artifact: Trigger-2 binding-router factorial generator v3/direct derivatives
audited_current_artifacts.delta: Supervisor 8.78 rejection remains binding; do not rescue v3 with marginal metrics.

material_findings.finding: For capability C and the Hyperposition carrier, linear decodability is a representation gate, not final functional acceptance.
material_findings.training_consequence: Keep frozen probe curves, but require matched behavioral/OOD use and a causal discriminator at the strongest exposed model interface before claiming that the trained internal state is functionally used.
acceptance_ladder: R1_REPRESENTATION: split-clean probe/subspace readout above preregistered threshold
R2_BEHAVIOR: unseen lexical/template/structure families solve the intended operation
R3_CAUSAL_USE: lesion/shuffle/rescue or equally strong matched intervention changes the intended behavior selectively
R4_MECHANISM_SCOPE: claim only the component/path actually identified; do not infer whole J-Space or faithful localization automatically

material_findings.finding: Systematic variable binding may emerge after an earlier shortcut/heuristic phase.
material_findings.training_consequence: At checkpoints, score not only final binder accuracy but nuisance-only accuracy, hop/depth generalization, unseen symbol/permutation transfer, and if available routing-head/residual-stream causal signatures. A transient aggregate gain cannot be assumed to be the intended binder.

material_findings.finding: Project measurements already describe semantic concepts as rank-2-to-4 subspaces, and current external work provides additional evidence that reasoning features can occupy low-dimensional subspaces rather than a single vector.
material_findings.training_consequence: Represent/evaluate the semantic Hyperposition carrier as structured branch-state/set information with rank-aware readout and branch-permutation equivariance. A single steering direction may remain a probe/control primitive but is not the ontology.

material_findings.finding: Even successful activation/subspace patching can create a behavioral effect through a dormant or off-path mechanism.
material_findings.training_consequence: Any future J-Space/Hyperposition causal promotion should include off-target controls, alternate-site controls, lesion/shuffle/rescue consistency and downstream re-entry receipts. Successful patching alone is insufficient for faithful-mechanism claims.

material_findings.finding: A failed linear probe/intervention does not logically prove absence of the target representation because nonlinear encodings are possible.
material_findings.training_consequence: Negative linear results narrow the linear-control hypothesis only. Use preregistered nonlinear/readout alternatives on fresh data if the decision is material; never retune a frozen holdout post hoc.

material_findings.finding: Exact duplicate suppression and correlated-evidence non-independence are different operations. The current labeler conflates them when causal_ancestry_id equality alone suppresses attachment.
material_findings.risk: A distinct observation that shares a source/model/pipeline ancestry can disappear from branch provenance, making later contradiction, replay and reliability analysis impossible; conversely, preserving it must not mint independent-evidence weight.
proposed_successor_invariant: same exact evidence_event_id or exact replay identity => idempotent duplicate, do not reattach
distinct evidence_event_id + same correlation/ancestry family => preserve as a correlated observation, independent_credit=false
distinct evidence_event_id + independently qualified ancestry => preserve and allow independent_credit=true only when the independence gate says so
D_resolve remains insensitive to recurrence/count unless an admitted discriminator relation changes branch status

material_findings.finding: Hyperposition semantics belong to branch content/relations, not arbitrary branch IDs or presentation order.
material_findings.training_consequence: For each HP family, construct branch-ID renamings and order permutations that preserve the semantic state up to the same permutation; require state-transition equivariance and keep IDs evaluator-only unless intentionally task-visible.

artifacts_not_invalidated: existing exact-duplicate idempotence tests as method donors

hypothesis_counterhypothesis.hypothesis: A Hyperposition-native curriculum with rank-aware/set-equivariant representation, exact event identity, correlated-evidence preservation and causal-use evaluation will transfer better to variable-grid reconciliation than a flat-label or single-direction curriculum.
hypothesis_counterhypothesis.counterhypothesis: The added latent structure may increase supervision complexity without improving end-task behavior; the model may learn the visible schema while ignoring it internally.
hypothesis_counterhypothesis.falsifier: At matched training tokens and frozen OOD families, compare a flat/legacy donor schedule against the Hyperposition-native successor. Reject the added structure if it does not improve branch-preservation/update, correlated-evidence arbitration, variable-N transfer and causal-use metrics while meeting retention floors.

next_exact_actions: Do not create a competing Trigger-2 lane; converge through PR #2009.
Add an evidence-event-vs-ancestry identity field contract and the five required labeler tests before positive D/E admission.
Promote C acceptance language from decodability-only to representation + behavior/OOD + causal-use scope.
Add branch-ID/order equivariance tests to the Hyperposition native generator before corpus scale-up.
Keep v3 binder rejected; use current full-cross/prompt-derived semantic-ablation successor gates before token materialization.
